(5) A third male voice with high vocal arousal and pitch enters quickly, marked by a 'bubble pop' SFX. (6) A loud 'stinger' or 'hit' SFX punctuates the mention of 'YouBike'. narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Chronological progression of expertise levels (1st year -> 3rd year -> 10th year) -> Final comedic failure.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously depict the learning curve of a Japanese resident in Taipei regarding the best transportation methods, evolving from the MRT to buses and finally to YouBike, while ending on a relatable comedic irony about forgetting the payment card.
